Blocked at step 1 (set-up): on production a technician's sign-in name and staff record name cannot be made different, so the set-up this test needs cannot exist there.

Tested on production, build v26.43.0-ffea43c, on 22 and 23 October 2026.

  • Set-up needed: a technician whose staff record name differs from the name on their sign-in account.
  • Tried seven ways with technician Carol Neal at Truck Hill 1, reading both names after each:
  • (1) signed in as her, Profile > Edit Profile, name changed to "David Sparks", "Change Name" pressed;
  • (2) the same change made while signed in as the admin, through account access;
  • (3) her name changed in Settings > Staff;
  • (4) her name changed in Settings > Staff while her account was deactivated, then reactivated;
  • (5) a second staff member added at Trucks Hill 2 with her email and another name: refused, "There is already a user with that email";
  • (6) adding her to a second location uses the same one staff record, so it cannot hold a second name;
  • (7) every technician at all 13 locations checked (130 people): every staff record name matches the sign-in name.
  • Each time both names changed together. Carol Neal was put back afterwards.
  • How it passed on staging on 21 October: staging already had a technician whose two names differed (sign-in "Carol Neal", staff record "David Sparks"), and every place showed the staff record name.

What needs to be done: nothing to fix in the product; the QA lead decides whether this test stays staging-only.
